scope: Fresh formatted installations only. No migration, operator-host repair, publication, credential change, partition replay or firmware change. Legacy CUDA workaround intentionally unchanged at user direction.

boundary.native: Identified extracted signed-package fixture in private networkless QEMU/TCG; no host mounts, sockets, session, devices, credentials, package state or service managers exposed. Guest runtime is private tmpfs; host images/captures/scratch are disk-backed.
boundary.host_execution: Only reviewed source/data checks, permitted pure serialization and explicit offline AppArmor parsing. No unittest discovery or target helper execution on host.

generation.repeat: Two successive builds produced identical bytes for all twelve flat suite products.
generation.checks: Unique regular contained members; uid/gid 0:0; source mode 0644; every manifest size/hash/member; current source membership and frontend identity. Source templates intentionally retain placeholders until target publication. Full final-target scan requires a complete installation.

fixture_limits: The repository guarded unittest suite remains UNRUN; its rootless-container guard was not bypassed. Test definitions and embedded child AST checks are source-only evidence.
Network NM/radio/authentication backends are simulated; actual lock/process/sanitization code ran under enforcement.
Swap identity/block/cryptsetup/mkswap/swapon backend operations are mocked; actual producer, serializer, renderer and whole consumer ran.
Menu actions use a private result sink through the actual fixed normalizer; actual destructive power actions and backend applications were not triggered.

Native Foot applications are real UID-1000 btop children on PTYs. Unit-constructor checks inspect actual argv with prerequisite guards mocked; no real managed systemd unit/cgroup or logged-in session is established.
Visual evidence uses actual production CSS and packaged fonts in a native status fixture. It does not cover internal/hover/drawer geometry or keyboard/network variants.
Notifier uses actual before/after helpers, controlled state/transport backends and active execution auditing. Metrics are guest/TCG observations, not physical desktop measurements.

Selected-unit collector subprocesses, deadlines, filesystem instance checks and receipt priority are real code; systemd manager responses are simulated. The unprovable child-reap branch uses a mock and creates no unkillable child. Firstboot enforcement/full boot remains a separate gate.
